mapper.select:
select a.id, a.plan_no, a.warehouse_code, a.warehouse_name, a.status, a.bill_type, a.factory_code, a.handle_state, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.create_by, a.update_by, a.del_flag from wms_inside_inventory_plan a left join wms_inside_inventory_plan_detail b on a.id = b.plan_id where a.del_flag = '0'
and a.plan_no like concat('%', #{params.planNo}, '%')
and a.warehouse_code = #{params.warehouseCode}
and b.mat_code like concat('%', #{params.matCode}, '%')
and b.mat_name like concat('%', #{params.matName}, '%')
GROUP BY id order by a.create_time desc, a.status asc
